assertions.assertion: The claim was for CPT code 93229.
The denial was issued under reason code CO-197.
The reason for denial was missing precertification/authorization.
The patient presents with recurrent palpitations.
The patient has a history of atrial fibrillation.
There is concern for intermittent arrhythmia recurrence.
The patient has a personal history of transient ischemic attack and cerebral infarction.
Continuous monitoring is indicated to detect potential embolic sources or rhythm disturbances.
Such embolic sources or rhythm disturbances may have been missed on standard ECG.
